messages.snippet: Dear Robert and Grace, I'm pleased to confirm that the Manufacturing and Supply Agreement with Calde
messages.subject: Project Cedar — completed and signed
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Robert and Grace,

I'm pleased to confirm that the Manufacturing and Supply Agreement with Caldera Mobility was executed today. I attach the signed execution version for your records; the Quality Agreement and SOW No. 1 were signed alongside it. Counterparts have been exchanged with Denham Lewis.

Congratulations to the whole team — this has been a well-run negotiation. We'll send our final invoice and a short closing note next week, and we remain available for any questions on first-article inspection and the tooling milestones.

Kind regards,
James

James Osei | Senior Associate
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0521
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
